questions.prompt: A population is 15% blue. Tap the draw button five times to collect five samples of 20 with replacement. What percent of all 100 draws were blue?
A population is 15% blue. Tap the draw button five times. Find the percent blue in Sample 1, then give its absolute difference from 15% in percentage points.
With equally likely draws from a 15% blue population, which procedure generates comparable random samples?

options: Pick blue items first
Change sample size after each blue draw
Replace after each draw and repeat samples of 20
